figurative_meaning_en: Time of death; state of dying
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অন্তিমদশায় পরিবারের সকলে তার পাশে ছিল।
অন্তিমদশায় সে তার সমস্ত সম্পত্তি ছেলেকে দিয়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: In his final moments, the entire family was by his side.
On his deathbed, he bequeathed all his property to his son.
note: This idiom is often used in formal or literary Bengali to describe the immediate period before death.
